Definition: to mark out, i.e. (primitive) scratch or (definite) imprint
BiblicalUsage: The word is to mark out, to scratch, to set a mark. David changed his behaviour before Achish and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard; and the man with the inkhorn is told to set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and cry.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the same hand that scratches a mark in madness sets a mark of mercy in Ezekiel's vision.
